title: fab-test.yml
description: Configuration schema for fab-test.yml, the optional config-file front door for the fab-test CLI. Every setting is optional; an absent key falls back to its environment variable (where one exists) and then its packaged default.

artifact_dir.description: Root directory to discover artifacts (default: .fabric/artifacts, or the repository root for `fab-test local`).

output_dir.description: Root directory for result envelopes and the run manifest (default: analyzer-results).

jobs.description: Number of artifacts to run in parallel for the same analyzer (default: 1).

format.description: Output format for aggregate summaries (default: text).

timeout.description: Per-artifact subprocess timeout in seconds [env: ANALYZER_TIMEOUT] (default: 120).

environment.description: Default environment label, e.g. DEV/PROD/ANY [env: FABRIC_ENVIRONMENT].

report.description: Write a readable HTML report beside each result envelope. Opt-in; false unless set. PBIR Inspector's own TestRun.html is unaffected and appears regardless.

workspace.description: Default Fabric workspace for targets that name an artifact but not a workspace. A display name or a GUID [env: FABRIC_WORKSPACE_ID]; a positional WORKSPACE.Workspace/NAME.Type target overrides it.

rules.description: Rule overlays: deltas applied to a packaged ruleset instead of forking it.

disable.description: Rule IDs to remove from the effective ruleset.

extend.description: Path to a JSON file of additional rules to append.
